tasks.title: Setup TypeScript Project Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with Node.js + TypeScript backend and Lit + TypeScript frontend using Vite
tasks.details: Set up the basic project structure with package.json, tsconfig.json for both frontend and backend, Vite configuration for the frontend build, Express.js setup for the backend API, and shared TypeScript interfaces. Create the folder structure: /backend (Express.js + TypeScript), /frontend (Lit + TypeScript + Vite), /shared (common TypeScript types and interfaces). Configure development scripts for both frontend and backend with hot reload.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project builds successfully, TypeScript compilation works for both frontend and backend, Vite dev server starts correctly, Express server starts without errors, and shared types are accessible from both frontend and backend

subtasks.title: Initialize Node.js project and install core dependencies
subtasks.description: Create package.json with Node.js project configuration and install essential dependencies for TypeScript, Express, Lit, and Vite
subtasks.details:
Initialize npm project with 'npm init'. Install core dependencies: typescript, @types/node, ts-node, ts-node-dev, nodemon for development. Install Express dependencies: express, @types/express, cors, @types/cors. Install frontend dependencies: vite, lit, @lit/reactive-element. Create npm scripts in package.json for 'dev' (concurrent frontend/backend), 'build' (production builds), 'dev:backend' (nodemon/ts-node-dev), 'dev:frontend' (vite dev). Set up workspaces configuration if using monorepo structure.

subtasks.testStrategy: Verify npm init creates package.json with correct structure. Test dependency installation using npm list to confirm all required packages are installed. Validate npm scripts exist and execute without errors using npm run commands. Check workspace configuration if monorepo is used. Use npm audit to ensure no critical vulnerabilities in dependencies.

subtasks.title: Configure TypeScript compilation settings
subtasks.description: Create and configure tsconfig.json files for backend, frontend, and shared code with appropriate compiler options
subtasks.details: Create root tsconfig.base.json with shared compiler options: target ES2020, module commonjs/ESNext, strict mode enabled, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck. Create backend/tsconfig.json extending base with: outDir './dist', rootDir './src', module 'commonjs', types for node. Create frontend/tsconfig.json extending base with: module 'ESNext', moduleResolution 'bundler', jsx 'preserve', DOM lib, decorators enabled for Lit. Create shared/tsconfig.json for common interfaces with declaration files output. Configure path mappings for '@shared/*' imports.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test TypeScript compilation in each directory using tsc --noEmit to verify configuration validity. Ensure isolatedModules and strict mode are properly configured. Verify path mappings resolve correctly by importing shared types. Test that backend compiles to CommonJS and frontend to ESNext modules. Check declaration file generation for shared interfaces.

subtasks.title: Set up Vite configuration for Lit frontend
subtasks.description: Configure Vite build tool with TypeScript and Lit support for the frontend application
subtasks.details: Create frontend/vite.config.ts with: base configuration for development server (port 5173), build output to 'dist' directory, resolve aliases for '@shared' path. Configure Vite plugins: @vitejs/plugin-lit for Lit components support. Set up proxy configuration to forward API requests to backend (localhost:3000). Configure build optimizations: rollup options for code splitting, CSS code split, sourcemap generation for development. Add index.html entry point with module script tag. Configure TypeScript decorators and experimental decorators support.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Vite dev server starts successfully on port 5173 using vite --config frontend/vite.config.ts. Verify alias resolution works by importing from '@shared' path. Test proxy configuration by making API requests to backend routes. Validate build process completes without errors using vite build. Check that TypeScript decorators compile correctly for Lit components. Verify hot module replacement works for component updates.

subtasks.title: Configure Express.js with TypeScript for backend API
subtasks.description: Set up Express server with TypeScript configuration, middleware, and basic routing structure
subtasks.details: Create backend/src/server.ts as main entry point with Express app initialization. Configure middleware stack: express.json(), cors with appropriate origins, compression, helmet for security headers. Set up error handling middleware with TypeScript error types. Create backend/src/routes/ directory structure for API routes organization. Configure environment variables with dotenv and type-safe config. Set up nodemon.json or use ts-node-dev for hot reload with ignore patterns for frontend/shared. Create backend/src/types/ for Express request/response type extensions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Express server starts without errors using ts-node-dev backend/src/server.ts. Verify middleware stack loads correctly by testing JSON parsing and CORS headers. Test error handling middleware catches and formats errors properly. Validate hot reload works by modifying files and checking server restarts. Test environment variable loading using different NODE_ENV values. Use supertest to verify basic server functionality and middleware operation.

subtasks.title: Create project folder structure and shared interfaces
subtasks.description: Establish the complete folder structure and create initial shared TypeScript interfaces that both frontend and backend will use
subtasks.details: Create directory structure: /backend/src/{routes,middleware,services,types}, /frontend/src/{components,views,services,styles}, /shared/src/{interfaces,types,constants}. Create shared/src/interfaces/index.ts with base interfaces: ISession, IMessage, ITodoItem, IUsageInfo matching Python model structure. Set up shared/package.json with 'main' and 'types' fields pointing to compiled output. Configure both frontend and backend to import from '@shared' using TypeScript path mappings. Create .gitignore with node_modules, dist, .cache patterns. Add README.md files in each major directory.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all required directories exist using ls commands. Test shared interface imports work in both frontend and backend by creating test files that import from '@shared'. Validate shared package.json configuration by checking npm pack output. Test .gitignore patterns by creating test files and verifying git status ignores them. Ensure TypeScript path mappings resolve correctly across all projects.

tasks.title: Implement TypeScript Data Models and JSONL Parser
tasks.description: Port Python data models to TypeScript and create JSONL parsing functionality
tasks.details: Convert the existing Python Pydantic models (from python/claude_code_log/models.py) to TypeScript interfaces and classes. Implement JSONL file parsing in Node.js using fs module to read Claude Code transcript files. Create data structures for UsageInfo, TodoItem, Message types, Session metadata. Ensure backward compatibility with existing JSONL format from the Python implementation. Add validation using libraries like zod for runtime type checking.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for JSONL parsing with existing test data from python/test/test_data/, verify data model compatibility with Python version, test parsing performance with large JSONL files, validate TypeScript interfaces match expected data structures

subtasks.title: Port Core Data Types and Basic Models
subtasks.description: Convert TodoItem, UsageInfo, and basic content types from Python models.py to TypeScript
subtasks.details: Start by creating TypeScript interfaces and types for the fundamental data structures. Port TodoItem with its id, content, and status fields. Convert UsageInfo with input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens. Define base content types including TextContent, ImageContent, and ToolUseContent interfaces. Ensure proper type definitions for enums and literal types used in the Python models.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests using Jest or Vitest to validate interface structure and type compatibility. Test type guards for discriminating between different content types. Verify enum values match Python equivalents by creating test objects. Use TypeScript compiler API to validate interfaces at runtime. Test serialization/deserialization of basic types to ensure JSON compatibility.

subtasks.title: Port Message Types and Transcript Entries
subtasks.description: Convert UserMessage, AssistantMessage, and TranscriptEntry types to TypeScript
subtasks.details: Port the message type hierarchy including UserMessage and AssistantMessage classes. Convert TranscriptEntry with its type discriminator pattern. Implement proper union types for message content arrays. Port the Session metadata structure with id, project_id, created_at, and updated_at fields. Ensure compatibility with the existing JSONL format's message structure and maintain the same field names and nesting.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test message type discrimination using TypeScript type guards and narrowing. Validate union type handling for content arrays with mixed content types. Compare JSON serialization output with Python equivalents using existing test data. Test session metadata parsing with various timestamp formats. Verify field name compatibility by parsing existing JSONL files.

subtasks.title: Implement JSONL File Reading and Streaming
subtasks.description: Create Node.js fs-based JSONL file reader with streaming support
subtasks.details: Implement JSONL file reading using Node.js fs module with both synchronous and asynchronous options. Create a streaming parser using readline or stream APIs for handling large files efficiently. Build line-by-line parsing logic that handles malformed JSON gracefully. Implement file watching capabilities for real-time updates. Add support for reading compressed JSONL files (.jsonl.gz). Create utility functions for file discovery and path resolution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test file reading with both small and large JSONL files using performance benchmarks. Verify streaming parser handles files larger than available memory. Test malformed JSON handling with deliberately corrupted test files. Validate file watching triggers correct callbacks using fs.watch events. Test compressed file reading with actual .jsonl.gz files. Use mock file system for isolated testing.

subtasks.title: Create Content Block and Tool Result Parsers
subtasks.description: Implement parsing logic for complex content blocks and tool execution results
subtasks.details: Build parsers for different content block types including text, images, and tool use blocks. Implement tool result parsing with proper handling of stdout, stderr, and error fields. Create parsers for thinking blocks and system messages. Handle nested content structures and mixed content arrays. Ensure proper deserialization of base64-encoded image data. Add support for parsing tool input parameters and maintaining their original types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each content block parser with examples from existing JSONL files. Verify tool result parsing handles all field combinations (stdout, stderr, error). Test base64 image decoding produces valid binary data. Validate nested content parsing with deeply nested structures. Test tool input parameter preservation maintains original JavaScript types. Use property-based testing for content block variations.

subtasks.title: Add Zod Schemas for Runtime Validation
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive Zod schemas for all data models with runtime type checking
subtasks.details: Define Zod schemas that mirror the TypeScript interfaces for runtime validation. Create schemas for TodoItem, UsageInfo, and all message types. Implement custom validators for complex fields like timestamps and IDs. Add schema composition for nested structures. Create validation functions that provide detailed error messages. Implement schema versioning support for backward compatibility. Add performance-optimized validation modes for production use.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Zod schemas validate correct data and reject invalid inputs with specific test cases. Verify custom validators for timestamps accept valid ISO strings and reject malformed dates. Test schema composition with nested validation. Benchmark validation performance with large datasets. Test error message clarity and usefulness for debugging. Validate schema versioning handles migration between data format versions.

subtasks.title: Implement Anthropic SDK Compatibility Layer
subtasks.description: Create compatibility layer for Anthropic message types and SDK integration
subtasks.details: Build type converters between internal models and Anthropic SDK types. Implement MessageParam and ContentBlock compatibility interfaces. Create adapters for tool use and tool result formats. Ensure proper handling of Anthropic-specific fields like cache_control and thinking blocks. Add type guards and conversion utilities for seamless SDK integration. Maintain compatibility with both old and new Anthropic message formats.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test type conversion roundtrip (internal → Anthropic → internal) maintains data integrity. Verify MessageParam compatibility with official Anthropic SDK examples. Test tool use format conversion with real tool execution results. Validate cache_control and thinking block field preservation. Test backward compatibility with older Anthropic message formats using archived examples.

subtasks.title: Create Comprehensive Unit Tests
subtasks.description: Develop unit tests using existing Python test data to verify compatibility
subtasks.details: Write unit tests for all model types using the existing test JSONL files from python/test/test_data/. Test parsing of complete session transcripts including edge cases. Verify backward compatibility by parsing Python-generated JSONL files. Test validation error handling and recovery. Create performance tests for large file parsing. Test streaming parser with interrupted reads. Verify that TypeScript models produce identical JSON output to Python models. Add regression tests for known parsing issues.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use Jest/Vitest to test all models with python/test/test_data/ files as fixtures. Compare JSON output between TypeScript and Python using deep equality checks. Test error recovery scenarios with corrupted test files. Benchmark parsing performance with files >100MB. Test streaming interruption by artificially stopping reads mid-file. Create snapshot tests to detect regressions in parsed output. Use property-based testing for parsing edge cases.

tasks.title: Build Backend API with Express.js and WebSocket Server
tasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for session data and real-time WebSocket communication
tasks.details: Implement Express.js server with TypeScript support. Create API endpoints: GET /api/sessions (list all sessions), GET /api/sessions/:id (get session details), GET /api/projects (list projects), POST /api/sessions/continue (trigger Claude Code session continuation). Set up WebSocket server using ws library for real-time updates when new sessions are created or modified. Add CORS configuration for frontend-backend communication. Implement file system monitoring using fs.watch to detect changes in JSONL files.
tasks.testStrategy: API endpoint testing with supertest, WebSocket connection testing, verify CORS configuration works, test file system monitoring triggers correct WebSocket events, validate API response schemas match TypeScript interfaces

subtasks.title: Set up Express.js server with TypeScript configuration
subtasks.description: Initialize Express.js server with TypeScript support, configure middleware stack, and set up development environment
subtasks.details: Create Express application with TypeScript configuration including tsconfig.json setup. Install required dependencies: express, @types/express, typescript, ts-node-dev for hot reloading. Set up middleware for body parsing (express.json), request logging (morgan), and error handling. Configure environment variables using dotenv for port configuration and API settings. Create basic server structure with src/server.ts entry point and proper TypeScript compilation setup.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Express server starts successfully with TypeScript compilation using supertest. Verify middleware stack loads in correct order by testing request/response flow. Test environment variable loading with different .env configurations. Validate hot reloading by modifying source files and checking server restarts. Test error handling middleware catches unhandled errors and returns proper HTTP status codes.

subtasks.title: Implement RESTful API endpoints for session management
subtasks.description: Create REST endpoints for listing sessions, retrieving session details, and managing projects
subtasks.details: Implement GET /api/sessions endpoint to return all sessions with pagination support. Create GET /api/sessions/:id endpoint to retrieve detailed session information including messages and metadata. Add GET /api/projects endpoint to list all unique projects from sessions. Implement POST /api/sessions/continue endpoint to trigger Claude Code session continuation. Use TypeScript interfaces from Task 2 for response typing. Add request validation middleware and proper HTTP status codes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use supertest for API endpoint testing with Express app instance. Test pagination with various limit/offset parameters and verify response structure. Test individual session retrieval with valid/invalid IDs. Validate API response schemas match TypeScript interfaces using JSON schema validation. Test request validation middleware rejects malformed requests with appropriate error messages. Verify proper HTTP status codes (200, 400, 404, 500) are returned.

subtasks.title: Create WebSocket server for real-time updates
subtasks.description: Set up WebSocket server using ws library to broadcast real-time session updates to connected clients
subtasks.details: Install and configure ws library for WebSocket support. Create WebSocket server on separate port or integrate with Express server using upgrade event. Implement connection handling with client authentication/identification. Define WebSocket message protocol for different event types: session_created, session_updated, session_deleted. Create broadcast mechanism to notify all connected clients of changes. Add heartbeat/ping-pong mechanism to detect disconnected clients.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test WebSocket connection establishment using ws client library. Verify message broadcast reaches all connected clients by creating multiple test connections. Test heartbeat/ping-pong mechanism prevents connection timeouts. Validate WebSocket message protocol with predefined message types. Test connection cleanup when clients disconnect unexpectedly. Use WebSocket testing utilities to simulate various connection scenarios.

subtasks.title: Implement file system monitoring for JSONL changes
subtasks.description: Set up fs.watch to monitor JSONL file changes and trigger WebSocket broadcasts
subtasks.details: Configure fs.watch or chokidar to monitor the Claude Code sessions directory for JSONL file changes. Implement debouncing mechanism to handle rapid file changes efficiently. Parse modified JSONL files to extract session changes and new messages. Create event emitter pattern to connect file system events to WebSocket broadcasts. Handle file creation, modification, and deletion events appropriately. Implement error handling for file system operations and inaccessible files.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test file system monitoring triggers correct events by creating/modifying/deleting test files. Verify debouncing prevents excessive event firing during rapid file changes. Test JSONL parsing on file change events handles corrupted files gracefully. Validate WebSocket broadcasts are triggered by file system events using integration tests. Test error handling with inaccessible files and permission issues. Use mock file system for isolated testing scenarios.

subtasks.title: Configure CORS and security middleware
subtasks.description: Set up CORS configuration, security headers, and request validation middleware
subtasks.details: Install and configure cors package with appropriate origin whitelist for frontend communication. Add helmet middleware for security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.). Implement rate limiting using express-rate-limit to prevent API abuse. Add input validation and sanitization middleware for all endpoints. Configure HTTPS support for production deployment. Set up API authentication mechanism if needed (JWT or API keys). Ensure WebSocket connections also respect CORS policies.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test CORS configuration allows frontend origins and blocks unauthorized origins using preflight OPTIONS requests. Verify security headers are present in responses using helmet testing. Test rate limiting blocks excessive requests and returns 429 status code. Validate input sanitization prevents XSS and injection attacks with malicious payloads. Test HTTPS configuration with self-signed certificates in development. Verify API authentication mechanisms reject invalid tokens/keys.

subtasks.title: Create API response schemas and error handling
subtasks.description: Define consistent API response formats, implement error handling, and add API documentation
subtasks.details: Define TypeScript interfaces for all API responses matching Python renderer data structures. Implement consistent error response format with error codes and messages. Create custom error classes for different error types (ValidationError, NotFoundError, etc.). Add global error handling middleware to catch and format all errors consistently. Implement request/response logging for debugging. Generate API documentation using tools like Swagger/OpenAPI. Add API versioning strategy for future compatibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate API response schemas match defined TypeScript interfaces using JSON schema validation. Test custom error classes generate appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages. Verify global error handler catches all unhandled errors and returns consistent format. Test request/response logging captures relevant information for debugging. Validate generated API documentation matches actual endpoint behavior. Test API versioning handles backward compatibility requirements.

tasks.title: Create Caching System with File System Integration
tasks.description: Implement TypeScript equivalent of the Python caching system for performance
tasks.details: Port the Python caching logic (from python/claude_code_log/cache.py) to TypeScript. Implement cache structure with session metadata, timestamp indexing, and cache invalidation based on file modification times. Use Node.js fs.stat for file modification tracking. Create cache management APIs: cache building, validation, and cleanup. Store cache as JSON files in .cache/ directories within project folders, maintaining compatibility with existing cache structure.
tasks.testStrategy: Test cache creation and invalidation, verify cache performance improvements, test cache compatibility with existing Python-generated cache files, validate file modification detection works correctly

subtasks.title: Port Cache Data Models and TypeScript Interfaces
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript interfaces and classes for CachedFileInfo, SessionCacheData, and ProjectCache matching Python structures
subtasks.details: Define TypeScript interfaces for all cache-related data structures from python/claude_code_log/cache.py. Include properties for file paths, modification times, cache versions, session metadata, and timestamp indexing. Ensure all interfaces maintain exact JSON structure compatibility with existing Python cache files. Add JSDoc comments for all interfaces and types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Compare TypeScript interface definitions with Python cache data structures using existing cache files. Test JSON serialization/deserialization roundtrip maintains data integrity. Validate interface compatibility by parsing existing Python-generated cache files. Verify JSDoc comments provide accurate type documentation. Use TypeScript compiler to validate interface definitions.

subtasks.title: Implement Cache Directory Management and Index Structure
subtasks.description: Create cache directory structure with .cache/ folders and index.json file management
subtasks.details: Implement functions to create and manage .cache/ directories within project folders. Create index.json file structure for storing cache metadata and session references. Build directory traversal logic to locate and manage multiple cache directories across different projects. Implement atomic file write operations to prevent cache corruption during updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test cache directory creation in various project structures with different permission levels. Verify index.json structure matches expected format by comparing with Python implementation. Test directory traversal finds all cache directories across complex project hierarchies. Validate atomic file operations prevent corruption during concurrent access using stress testing. Test cleanup of orphaned cache directories.

subtasks.title: Build File Modification Tracking System
subtasks.description: Implement file modification time tracking using Node.js fs.stat for cache invalidation
subtasks.details: Create file watcher service using fs.stat to track modification times of cached files. Build comparison logic to detect when files have changed since last cache update. Implement efficient batch file checking to minimize file system operations. Add support for tracking both individual files and entire directory trees.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test file modification detection accuracy by modifying files and verifying detection. Benchmark batch file checking performance with large file sets (1000+ files). Test directory tree tracking handles nested structures correctly. Validate modification time comparison handles various file systems and timestamp precision. Test file watcher service handles deleted/moved files gracefully.

subtasks.title: Create Cache Validation and Version Compatibility
subtasks.description: Implement cache validation logic with version checking for Python/TypeScript compatibility
subtasks.details: Build cache validation functions to verify cache integrity and structure. Implement version compatibility checking between Python and TypeScript cache formats. Create migration logic for handling different cache versions. Add checksum validation to detect corrupted cache files. Implement graceful fallback when cache validation fails.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test cache validation with valid and corrupted cache files to verify detection accuracy. Test version compatibility with various Python cache versions. Validate migration logic preserves data integrity across versions. Test checksum validation detects file corruption by artificially corrupting test files. Verify graceful fallback rebuilds cache when validation fails.

subtasks.title: Implement JSONL Cache Building and Parsing
subtasks.description: Build cache generation from JSONL session files with efficient streaming parsers
subtasks.details: Create streaming JSONL parser for processing large session files efficiently. Implement cache building logic that extracts relevant metadata from JSONL entries. Build incremental cache updates to avoid full rebuilds when possible. Add support for parallel processing of multiple JSONL files. Implement memory-efficient processing for large session histories.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test streaming parser handles files larger than available memory without memory leaks. Verify cache building extracts correct metadata by comparing with manual parsing. Test incremental updates only process changed files using before/after comparisons. Benchmark parallel processing performance with multiple large files. Monitor memory usage during processing of large session histories.

subtasks.title: Develop Cache Invalidation and Update Logic
subtasks.description: Create intelligent cache invalidation based on file changes and timestamp comparisons
subtasks.details: Implement cache invalidation rules based on file modification times and content changes. Create selective cache updates that only rebuild affected portions. Build dependency tracking to cascade invalidation when related files change. Add cache expiration policies based on age and usage patterns. Implement cache warming strategies for frequently accessed data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test cache invalidation triggers correctly when files are modified using simulated file changes. Verify selective updates only rebuild necessary cache portions by monitoring rebuild activity. Test dependency tracking cascades invalidation to related cache entries. Validate cache expiration removes stale entries based on configurable policies. Test cache warming improves performance for frequently accessed data.

subtasks.title: Build Project-Level Cache Aggregation APIs
subtasks.description: Create APIs for aggregating cache data across projects for statistics and analytics
subtasks.details: Implement aggregation functions to combine cache data from multiple sessions and projects. Create statistical summaries including session counts, message volumes, and token usage. Build efficient query APIs for filtering and searching cached data. Add support for time-based aggregations and trend analysis. Implement cache statistics endpoints for monitoring cache performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test aggregation functions produce accurate statistics by comparing with manual calculations. Verify query APIs return correct filtered results using various filter combinations. Test time-based aggregations handle different time ranges and granularities. Validate cache statistics endpoints provide useful performance metrics. Benchmark query performance with large aggregated datasets.

subtasks.title: Test Python Cache Compatibility and Performance
subtasks.description: Comprehensive testing of cache system compatibility with existing Python cache files
subtasks.details: Create unit tests for all cache operations including read, write, and invalidation. Test compatibility by reading Python-generated cache files and verifying data integrity. Benchmark cache performance against direct file system operations. Test cache behavior under concurrent access scenarios. Validate cache cleanup and garbage collection work correctly. Create integration tests with the Express.js backend API.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use Jest/Vitest for comprehensive unit testing of all cache operations with mocked file system. Test Python cache compatibility using actual cache files from python implementation. Benchmark cache vs direct file access performance with large datasets. Test concurrent access using multiple worker threads simulating simultaneous operations. Verify cache cleanup removes unused entries and garbage collection frees memory. Create integration tests with Express API endpoints using supertest.

tasks.title: Develop Lit Web Components for Session Visualization
tasks.description: Build the core frontend components using Lit for displaying sessions and messages
tasks.details: Create Lit Web Components for: SessionList (displays all sessions with filtering), SessionDetail (shows individual session with messages), MessageCard (renders individual messages with syntax highlighting), FilterBar (real-time filtering controls), Timeline (interactive timeline view). Implement reactive properties for real-time updates from WebSocket connections. Add syntax highlighting using libraries like Prism.js. Ensure components inherit styling from original Python templates to maintain visual continuity.
tasks.testStrategy: Component unit testing with Lit testing utilities, visual regression testing against Python HTML output, test reactive property updates from WebSocket events, verify syntax highlighting works correctly

subtasks.title: Set up Lit component architecture and base styling system
subtasks.description: Initialize the Lit framework infrastructure with base component class, shared styling system, and CSS custom properties for theming
subtasks.details: Create a base LitElement class that all components will inherit from. Set up CSS custom properties for colors, spacing, typography that match the Python template styles. Configure shadow DOM styling strategies and shared style sheets. Import and configure any required Lit decorators and utilities. Set up a components directory structure with index files for exports.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test base component instantiation and inheritance using @lit-labs/testing fixtures. Verify CSS custom properties are accessible in shadow DOM by checking computed styles. Test shared style sheets apply correctly across multiple component instances. Validate component directory structure exports work by importing components from index files. Use Lit testing utilities to test component lifecycle methods.

subtasks.title: Build SessionList component with filtering and sorting
subtasks.description: Create the SessionList component that displays all sessions with reactive filtering, sorting capabilities, and session metadata display
subtasks.details: Implement SessionList as a Lit component with reactive properties for sessions array, filter criteria, and sort order. Create session item rendering with timestamp, message count, and session ID display. Add click handlers for session selection. Implement filtering logic for session search by ID, date range, or content. Add sorting options for date, message count, or alphabetical. Port the session list styling from Python templates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test reactive property updates trigger re-renders using csrFixture. Verify session item rendering displays correct data by testing with mock session objects. Test click handlers dispatch correct events using event listeners. Validate filtering logic with various filter criteria and session data sets. Test sorting functionality produces correctly ordered results. Compare rendered output with Python template using visual regression testing.

subtasks.title: Create SessionDetail component for message display
subtasks.description: Develop the SessionDetail component to show individual session content with all messages in chronological order
subtasks.details: Build SessionDetail component with reactive property for selected session data. Implement message list rendering with proper ordering and grouping. Add session metadata header showing session ID, timestamp, duration, and message count. Create scrollable message container with virtual scrolling for performance with large message lists. Implement message type indicators (user, assistant, system). Port session detail layout and styling from Python templates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test session data property updates refresh component display using ssrHydratedFixture. Verify message ordering and grouping logic with chronological message data. Test session metadata calculation displays accurate information. Validate virtual scrolling performance with large message lists (1000+ messages). Test message type indicators visually distinguish different message types. Compare layout with Python templates using screenshot testing.

subtasks.title: Implement MessageCard with syntax highlighting
subtasks.description: Build the MessageCard component for rendering individual messages with proper formatting and syntax highlighting for code blocks
subtasks.details: Create MessageCard component with support for different message types (text, code, mixed content). Integrate Prism.js for syntax highlighting with automatic language detection. Implement markdown rendering for formatted text content. Add copy-to-clipboard functionality for code blocks. Style message cards with role-based visual indicators (user vs assistant). Handle tool use displays and structured data rendering. Port message card styling from Python templates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test message type rendering with various content types using fixture data. Verify Prism.js syntax highlighting works correctly by testing with different programming languages. Test markdown rendering produces correct HTML output. Validate copy-to-clipboard functionality using simulated user interactions. Test role-based styling applies different visual indicators. Verify tool use displays render structured data correctly.

subtasks.title: Build FilterBar with reactive filtering controls
subtasks.description: Create the FilterBar component with real-time filtering controls that update other components reactively
subtasks.details: Implement FilterBar with input fields for text search, date range pickers, message type filters, and session status filters. Create reactive properties that emit filter change events. Add debounced search input for performance. Implement filter preset buttons for common queries. Add clear filters functionality. Create collapsible advanced filter section. Style the filter bar to match Python template design.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test filter input fields update reactive properties correctly using user interaction simulation. Verify filter change events are emitted with correct data payloads. Test debounced search prevents excessive event firing with rapid input. Validate filter preset buttons apply correct filter combinations. Test clear filters resets all filter states. Test collapsible section toggles visibility correctly.

subtasks.title: Create Timeline component for temporal navigation
subtasks.description: Develop an interactive Timeline component for visualizing and navigating sessions chronologically
subtasks.details: Build Timeline component with D3.js or native SVG for rendering timeline visualization. Implement zoom and pan controls for timeline navigation. Add session markers with visual indicators for session length and message density. Create hover tooltips showing session preview information. Implement click-to-navigate functionality to jump to specific sessions. Add time range selection for filtering. Style timeline with colors and markers from Python templates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test timeline rendering displays correct temporal data using mock session datasets. Verify zoom and pan controls update view correctly with mouse/touch interactions. Test session markers accurately represent session length and message density. Validate hover tooltips show relevant session information. Test click navigation dispatches correct events with session IDs. Test time range selection updates timeline display correctly.

subtasks.title: Port CSS styles from Python templates
subtasks.description: Extract and adapt all CSS styles from existing Python templates to maintain visual consistency across the new Lit components
subtasks.details: Extract all CSS from Python Jinja2 templates in python/claude_code_log/templates/. Convert CSS to Lit's CSS template literal format. Adapt styles for shadow DOM encapsulation where needed. Create shared style modules for common patterns. Ensure responsive design is maintained. Test visual parity between Python and Lit rendered components. Document any style customization points for future theming.
subtasks.testStrategy: Compare extracted CSS with original Python templates for completeness using file diff tools. Test CSS template literals render correctly in shadow DOM by checking computed styles. Verify responsive design works across different viewport sizes using browser automation. Test visual parity with Python output using screenshot comparison tools. Validate shared style modules prevent code duplication. Document style customization points for theming support.

tasks.title: Implement Real-time WebSocket Communication
tasks.description: Add WebSocket-driven live updates for session changes and new data
tasks.details: Integrate WebSocket client in Lit components to receive real-time updates. Implement WebSocket message types: SESSION_CREATED, SESSION_UPDATED, SESSION_DELETED, CACHE_INVALIDATED. Add automatic reconnection logic with exponential backoff. Update Lit components reactively when WebSocket messages are received. Handle connection state in UI (connected/disconnected indicators). Implement message queuing for offline scenarios.
tasks.testStrategy: WebSocket connection testing, verify real-time updates work correctly in UI, test reconnection logic, validate message queuing during disconnections, test WebSocket error handling

subtasks.title: Create WebSocket Client Service
subtasks.description: Build a centralized WebSocket client service module in TypeScript for managing WebSocket connections
subtasks.details: Create a WebSocketService class that handles connection initialization, configuration with server URL, and basic connection lifecycle. Implement singleton pattern to ensure single WebSocket instance across the application. Add TypeScript interfaces for WebSocket configuration options including URL, protocols, and connection timeouts. Set up event emitter pattern for distributing messages to multiple listeners throughout the application.

subtasks.title: Define Message Protocol and Types
subtasks.description: Establish WebSocket message types and protocol for session-related real-time updates
subtasks.details: Create TypeScript interfaces and enums for message types: SESSION_CREATED, SESSION_UPDATED, SESSION_DELETED, CACHE_INVALIDATED. Define message payload structures for each type including session IDs, timestamps, and change details. Implement message serialization/deserialization utilities. Create type guards for runtime validation of incoming messages. Document message protocol for backend implementation reference.

subtasks.title: Implement Automatic Reconnection Logic
subtasks.description: Add robust reconnection mechanism with exponential backoff strategy for connection failures
subtasks.details: Implement exponential backoff algorithm starting at 1 second, doubling up to maximum 30 seconds. Add connection retry counter with configurable maximum attempts. Handle different disconnection scenarios: network failures, server restarts, idle timeouts. Implement jitter to prevent thundering herd problem. Add connection health check with periodic ping/pong messages. Create reconnection state management to track retry attempts and backoff delays.

subtasks.title: Add Connection State Management and UI Indicators
subtasks.description: Create connection state tracking system with visual indicators in the user interface
subtasks.details: Implement connection state enum: CONNECTING, CONNECTED, RECONNECTING, DISCONNECTED, ERROR. Create Lit component for connection status indicator with appropriate icons and colors. Add toast notifications for connection state changes. Implement connection statistics tracking (uptime, reconnection count, latency). Create debugging panel showing WebSocket connection details. Add accessibility announcements for screen readers when connection state changes.

subtasks.title: Integrate WebSocket Updates with Lit Components
subtasks.description: Connect WebSocket message handlers to Lit component reactive properties for automatic UI updates
subtasks.details: Create custom Lit controller for WebSocket subscription management in components. Implement reactive property updates when receiving SESSION_CREATED, SESSION_UPDATED, SESSION_DELETED messages. Add optimistic UI updates with rollback on failure. Create HOC (Higher Order Component) pattern for WebSocket-enabled components. Implement efficient change detection to minimize unnecessary re-renders. Add debouncing for rapid successive updates to prevent UI thrashing.

subtasks.title: Implement Offline Message Queuing and Synchronization
subtasks.description: Build message queuing system for offline scenarios with synchronization on reconnection
subtasks.details: Create IndexedDB-based message queue for storing outgoing messages during offline periods. Implement queue persistence with maximum size limits and TTL for old messages. Add message deduplication to prevent duplicate sends after reconnection. Create synchronization protocol to reconcile client and server state after reconnection. Implement conflict resolution strategy for concurrent updates. Add progress indicators for queue synchronization process.

tasks.title: Add Session Continuation and Claude Code Integration
tasks.description: Implement the ability to resume and continue Claude Code sessions directly from the web interface
tasks.details: Create Node.js child process management to launch Claude Code CLI from the web interface. Implement context preparation and transfer mechanisms to pass session history to Claude Code. Add API endpoints for session continuation: POST /api/sessions/:id/continue (resume existing session), POST /api/sessions/new (start new session from context). Create secure process spawning using child_process.spawn with proper environment setup. Add session status tracking (active/inactive) and process management.
tasks.testStrategy: Test child process spawning and management, verify Claude Code CLI integration works correctly, test context transfer mechanisms, validate security of process execution, test session status tracking

subtasks.title: Research Claude Code CLI interface and command structure
subtasks.description: Analyze Claude Code CLI documentation, command-line arguments, and invocation patterns to understand how to properly spawn and interact with the CLI from Node.js
subtasks.details: Study Claude Code CLI documentation for command structure, available flags, and arguments. Investigate how Claude Code accepts context input (--resume flag, context files, stdin). Document the CLI's output format and how it communicates status. Identify environment variables and configuration requirements. Research best practices for integrating with Claude Code programmatically.

subtasks.title: Design secure child process architecture and sandboxing strategy
subtasks.description: Create a secure architecture for spawning Claude Code processes with proper isolation, resource limits, and security boundaries
subtasks.details: Design process isolation strategy using Node.js child_process with restricted permissions. Implement sandboxing with limited file system access and network restrictions. Define resource limits (CPU, memory, execution time). Create security policies for environment variable handling. Design process user/group isolation if needed. Document threat model and security considerations.

subtasks.title: Implement session context extraction and serialization
subtasks.description: Build functionality to extract relevant context from existing web sessions and serialize it for Claude Code consumption
subtasks.details: Create context extraction logic to pull session history, messages, and metadata from the database. Implement serialization format compatible with Claude Code's expected input (JSONL or context file format). Build context trimming logic to handle token limits. Add support for extracting file references and project context. Implement context validation to ensure compatibility.

subtasks.title: Build context preparation and formatting module
subtasks.description: Create a module that prepares and formats extracted context into the proper structure for Claude Code initialization
subtasks.details: Implement context formatter that converts extracted session data to Claude Code's expected format. Build template system for context preparation with variable substitution. Add support for different context types (conversation history, file contents, project structure). Create context compression and optimization logic. Implement context file generation or stdin preparation based on CLI requirements.

subtasks.title: Implement secure process spawning and lifecycle management
subtasks.description: Create the core process management system for spawning, monitoring, and controlling Claude Code processes
subtasks.details: Implement secure child_process.spawn with proper options (shell: false, detached process groups). Create process lifecycle manager with state tracking (spawning, running, terminating). Build process monitoring with health checks and timeout handling. Implement graceful shutdown and force kill mechanisms. Add process resource monitoring and limits enforcement. Create process pool management for concurrent sessions.

subtasks.title: Create session continuation API endpoints
subtasks.description: Build REST API endpoints for initiating session continuation and managing Claude Code processes
subtasks.details: Implement POST /api/sessions/:id/continue endpoint for resuming existing sessions. Create POST /api/sessions/new endpoint for starting new sessions from context. Add GET /api/sessions/:id/status endpoint for process status checking. Implement DELETE /api/sessions/:id/process for terminating processes. Add request validation, authentication, and authorization checks. Create response schemas with proper error handling.

subtasks.title: Implement comprehensive security measures and validation
subtasks.description: Add security layers including input validation, command injection prevention, and audit logging
subtasks.details: Implement input sanitization for all user-provided data before process spawning. Add command injection prevention with argument escaping and validation. Create audit logging for all process operations and security events. Implement rate limiting for process spawning endpoints. Add security headers and CSRF protection. Create allowlist for permitted Claude Code arguments and flags.

subtasks.title: Build error handling and process cleanup system
subtasks.description: Create robust error handling for process failures and implement automatic cleanup mechanisms
subtasks.details: Implement comprehensive error handling for process spawn failures, crashes, and timeouts. Create automatic cleanup for orphaned processes and temporary files. Build retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures. Implement error recovery strategies and fallback mechanisms. Add detailed error logging and diagnostics. Create cleanup scheduler for abandoned sessions.

subtasks.title: Create UI controls and status indicators for session continuation
subtasks.description: Build frontend components for initiating session continuation and displaying process status
subtasks.details: Create 'Continue in Claude Code' button component with loading states. Implement process status indicator showing active/inactive/error states. Build progress feedback for context preparation and process spawning. Add error message display with user-friendly explanations. Create session continuation history view. Implement WebSocket updates for real-time status changes. Add confirmation dialogs for potentially destructive operations.

tasks.title: Build Interactive Filtering and Search Features
tasks.description: Implement real-time filtering, searching, and navigation capabilities
tasks.details: Create advanced filtering system with: message type filtering (user, assistant, tool use, thinking), date range filtering with natural language support, full-text search across session content, project-based filtering. Implement search indexing for performance using libraries like lunr.js or fuse.js. Add filter presets and saved searches. Create URL routing for deep-linking to specific filtered views. Ensure filtering works in real-time as user types.
tasks.testStrategy: Test filtering performance with large datasets, verify search accuracy and relevance, test date range parsing, validate URL routing and deep-linking, test filter combination scenarios

subtasks.title: Implement Message Type Filtering System
subtasks.description: Create filtering logic for different message types (user, assistant, tool use, thinking)
subtasks.details: Build the core filtering infrastructure to handle message type categorization. Create TypeScript interfaces for filter states and message types. Implement filter functions that can process sessions based on message type criteria. Add UI controls for toggling message type filters with checkboxes or toggle buttons. Ensure the filtering logic can handle multiple selected types simultaneously.

subtasks.title: Add Natural Language Date Range Parsing
subtasks.description: Implement date filtering with natural language support using date parsing libraries
subtasks.details: Integrate a natural language date parsing library like chrono-js or date-fns. Create input components that accept both standard date formats and natural language inputs like 'yesterday', 'last week', 'past 3 days'. Build date range validation and normalization functions. Implement the filtering logic to match sessions within specified date ranges. Add visual date picker as an alternative input method.

subtasks.title: Create Full-Text Search with Indexing
subtasks.description: Implement search indexing using lunr.js or fuse.js for performant full-text search
subtasks.details: Evaluate and choose between lunr.js and fuse.js based on performance requirements and feature set. Create indexing pipeline that processes session content on load and updates. Build search index structure including message content, metadata, and session information. Implement search ranking and relevance scoring. Add highlighting of search terms in results. Create background indexing for large datasets to avoid UI blocking.

subtasks.title: Build Project-Based Filtering System
subtasks.description: Implement filtering by project directories and workspace contexts
subtasks.details: Parse and extract project information from session metadata and file paths. Create project categorization logic based on directory structures. Build UI components for project selection with autocomplete. Implement project hierarchy navigation if nested projects exist. Add project path validation and normalization. Create project filter persistence in local storage.

subtasks.title: Implement Filter Combination Logic and State Management
subtasks.description: Create state management system for combining multiple filters with AND/OR logic
subtasks.details: Design filter state architecture using a state management pattern (Redux-like or MobX-like). Implement filter combination logic supporting AND/OR operations between different filter types. Create filter pipeline that efficiently applies multiple filters in sequence. Build debouncing mechanism for real-time filtering as user types. Add filter count indicators showing how many results match current filters. Implement filter reset and clear functionality.

subtasks.title: Add URL Routing for Filter Persistence
subtasks.description: Implement URL-based filter state for deep-linking and sharing filtered views
subtasks.details: Create URL parameter schema for encoding all filter states (message types, date ranges, search queries, projects). Implement bidirectional sync between URL parameters and filter state. Add browser history management for back/forward navigation with filters. Create shareable link generation for current filter configuration. Implement URL validation and error handling for malformed filter parameters. Add URL shortening or compression for complex filter combinations.

subtasks.title: Create Saved Searches and Filter Presets
subtasks.description: Build system for saving, managing, and applying filter presets and saved searches
subtasks.details: Design data structure for storing filter presets with names and descriptions. Implement local storage or IndexedDB persistence for saved searches. Create UI for managing presets including create, edit, delete, and apply operations. Add preset categories like 'Recent', 'Frequent', 'Custom'. Implement quick filter buttons for common searches (today's sessions, errors only, etc.). Add import/export functionality for sharing filter presets between users.

tasks.title: Implement Responsive Design with Tailwind CSS
tasks.description: Create a responsive, mobile-friendly interface using Tailwind CSS utility classes
tasks.details: Integrate Tailwind CSS with Vite build system. Create responsive layouts that work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Implement component styling using Tailwind utility classes while maintaining visual continuity with the original Python HTML templates. Add dark/light theme support using Tailwind's dark mode features. Create responsive navigation patterns and ensure touch-friendly interactions on mobile devices. Optimize for accessibility with proper ARIA labels and keyboard navigation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test responsive behavior across different screen sizes, verify accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), test theme switching functionality, validate touch interactions on mobile devices, test keyboard navigation

tasks.title: Add Export Capabilities and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Implement export features and optimize performance for large session datasets
tasks.details: Add export functionality: export sessions to HTML, JSON, or PDF formats. Implement lazy loading and virtualization for large session lists using techniques like intersection observer API. Add service worker for offline support and progressive web app features. Optimize bundle size with code splitting and tree shaking in Vite. Add compression for large session data transfers. Implement pagination or infinite scrolling for large datasets. Add performance monitoring and analytics.
tasks.testStrategy: Test export functionality with various formats, verify lazy loading performance improvements, test offline functionality with service worker, validate bundle size optimizations, test pagination with large datasets, performance testing with large session histories
